maya (Marketing): Quick sync: Nimbus asked for a co-marketing push in mid-July. They want a marketplace tile + joint webinar + a short benchmark blog. Can we assign owners?
diego (Partnerships): I'll handle Nimbus coordination and legal ask. They'll need co-branded assets and claims cleared.
zoe (Growth): For inbound leads, Nimbus will post to our webhook. We should map region->SDR and add utm_source=nimbus_tile. Who owns the mapping?
erin (Ops): Ops can set the HubSpot endpoint. Need sample payload to map fields.
sam (Content): I can draft the blog + webinar outline. Suggest webinar format 25m talk + 10 Q&A, focus on practical cost/latency tradeoffs.
ravi (Sales Eng): I'll run comparative benches: Redwood inference on Nimbus infra vs Nimbus baseline. Deliver CSV + short methodology by Thu.
integration-bot (WebhookBot): Please include example JSON: {"email","company","region","interest_level","utm"} for validation.
maya (Marketing): Owners recap: Bench -> @ravi (Thu), Blog+deck -> @sam (Mon), Webhook mapping -> @erin (test Thurs 11am PT), Legal/coordination -> @diego.
zoe (Growth): Lead scoring: marketplace leads become MQL if demo_requested=true OR intent_score>=7. We'll tag campaign=nimbus_co_marketing_jul2025.
erin (Ops): Noted. We'll avoid absolute % claims on the tile; link to appendix for numbers. I'll post test webhook to #marketing-tests once set up.
diego (Partnerships): Nimbus also asked for a co-registration page. They prefer registration on their site; we just need the webhook back.
sam (Content): I'll prepare a one-page appendix (CSV + methodology) to gate behind the landing.
maya (Marketing): Great — followups here as pieces land. :rocket:
